requirements.description: Be at least in the 8th grade.
Read the story of Philip tutoring the Ethiopian eunuch in Acts 8:26-40.
Describe the social conditions that make it more difficult for underprivileged children to acquire basic reading and math skills during elementary school.

Explain the main types of community-based tutoring programs:
  a) In-school, cross-age tutoring.
  b) After-school or weekend program.
  c) Community homework center.
Explain the difference between one-on-one tutoring and small-group classes, and list the pros and cons of each approach.
List the basic duties included in the job description of a volunteer tutor in a community-based tutoring program.
Describe the resources or tools a volunteer tutor uses in a community-based tutoring program.
Complete at least 10 tutoring sessions with a younger child.
